text.tspan: Share of total government spending by purpose of government activity. Categories are based on the
Classification of the Functions of Government (COFOG).

tspan.tspan: Data for general government, which includes central, state, and local governments and social security funds. For the US, environmental

text.tspan: protection spending is included in "Housing and community amenities" and "Economic affairs."
